```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)
library(arrow)
library(scales)
library(lubridate)

# ==========================================
# 2. GOOGLE TRENDS DATA PREP
# ==========================================
all_df <- read_csv("data/clean/clean_time_series_US_5.csv")

# Convert to tidy format and rename
tidy_df <- all_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(matcha, matcha_latte, strawberry_ml, boba, psl),
    names_to = "keyword",
    values_to = "interest"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    keyword = recode(
      keyword,
      matcha = "Matcha",
      matcha_latte = "Matcha Latte",
      strawberry_ml = "Strawberry Matcha Latte",
      boba = "Boba",
      psl = "Pumpkin Spice Latte"
    )
  )

# Filter for recent trends
trends_recent <- tidy_df |>
  filter(time >= as.Date("2016-01-01"), keyword != "Strawberry Matcha Latte")

# Rolling Average Dataframe
rol_avg <- trends_recent |>
  group_by(keyword) |>
  arrange(time) |>
  mutate(rolling_avg = rollmean(interest, k = 6, fill = NA))

# Matcha Beverages Dataframe 
matcha_beverages <- tidy_df |>
  filter(keyword %in% c("Matcha Latte", "Strawberry Matcha Latte"),
         time >= as.Date("2016-01-01"))

# Monthly Seasonality Dataframe
monthly_avg <- tidy_df |>
  mutate(month = month(time, label = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(keyword, month) |>
  summarise(avg_interest = mean(interest), .groups = 'drop')

# ==========================================
# 3. TIKTOK DATA PREP
# ==========================================
tiktok_data <- read_parquet("data/clean/clean_tiktok_data.parquet")

plot_data <- tiktok_data |>
  mutate(
    caption_lower = tolower(caption),
    category = case_when(
      str_detect(caption_lower, "starbucks") ~ "Starbucks",
      str_detect(caption_lower, "ceremonial") ~ "Ceremonial",
      str_detect(caption_lower, "latte") ~ "Latte",
      TRUE ~ "General Matcha"
    )
  ) |>
  select(-caption_lower)
```

# Search Trends (Google)

## Row {height="55%"}

### Macro Overview: Search Interest (2016-2026)
```{r}
ggplot(trends_recent, aes(x = time, y = interest, color = keyword)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) + 
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") + 
  facet_wrap(~keyword, scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(
    title = "Smoothed Google Search Interest by Beverage", 
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Search Interest") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )
```

### Momentum: 6-Month Rolling Average
```{r}
ggplot(rol_avg, aes(x = time, y = rolling_avg, color = keyword)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") + 
  labs(
    title = "6-Month Rolling Average of Beverage Search Interest",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rolling Average Interest") + 
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )
```

## Row {height="45%"}

### Seasonality: Average Monthly Interest
```{r}
ggplot(monthly_avg, aes(x = month, y = avg_interest, color = keyword, group = keyword)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Monthly Search Interest",
    subtitle = "An average of each month from 2016 - 2026",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Interest") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
```

# Social Intent (TikTok) {orientation="columns"}

## Column {width="60%"}

### Purchase Intent: Saves vs. Views
```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = views, y = saves, color = category)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) + 
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) + 
  labs(
    title = "Intent to Purchase: Saves vs. Views",
    subtitle = "Comparing engagement behavior across matcha market segments",
    x = "Total Views (Log Scale)",
    y = "Total Saves (Log Scale)",
    color = "Market Segment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
```

## Column {width="40%"}

### Engagement Depth by Niche
```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(category, engagement_rate, FUN = median), 
                      y = engagement_rate, 
                      fill = category)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, 0.3)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Engagement Rates by Niche",
    subtitle = "Ceremonial vs. Commercial performance",
    x = "Market Segment",
    y = "Engagement Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )
```
